title: [HFO-18] Connect drill and generator records to the checklist first
scope: source only; first two domain adapters on the COL-147 mechanism; no hosted apply, deploy, rule, schedule, deadline, reminder, UI, provider, staff or operating acceptance
model_used: Fable 5.1 / claude-fable-5-1 (implementer); independent reviewer seat: general-purpose subagent, read-only, SQL scenarios run inside BEGIN…ROLLBACK on col154_base347

findings.finding: A final fire/elopement drill corrected to tornado stranded its live receipt: the new version delivered nothing, the void delivered nothing, and the fire occurrence stayed satisfied by version 1 forever (reproduced by the reviewer).
findings.fix: correct_drill_log refuses any change between a linked type and tornado on a final log ('Drill type cannot change to or from tornado; void the log and record it again', 22023). A fire↔elopement change is delivered and handled by 346 by source identity.
findings.reverified: probe 5a: fire→tornado and tornado→fire refused with no restatement (version and type unchanged); fire→elopement onto an occurrence another record satisfied is a visible conflict with attention and the earlier receipt stays effective, exactly one effective receipt for the record; both probes PASS

findings.finding: Voiding an observation after its asset was retired marked the record voided while the 346 delivery was unmatched/subject_not_current, leaving the occurrence completed by the voided record's receipt (reproduced).
findings.fix: void_asset_observation refuses by name when the asset is retired, deleted or moved ('Asset is not current at this site; the observation stays as history until a historical-record scope exists'); correct already refused. The COL-133 retired-subject boundary hides the occurrence and the 341 authority lock would deny the reversal in any case, so a clean refusal is the honest behaviour; recorded as OWNER-DECISIONS 3k(xii). Reordering 346's subject check for voided deliveries was considered and rejected for this segment because the session authority lock still denies work on a hidden occurrence and a subject-less invalidated row would be unreadable.
findings.reverified: probe 3a: with the generator retired, void and correct are refused by name; record, occurrence, receipts and request ledger unchanged; un-retiring restores the path

findings.finding: The 220 unique constraint (site, type, date, time) is not partial, so a voided drill blocks re-entering a log at the same slot (23505); a partial index would break the legacy page's ON CONFLICT upsert.
findings.fix: Recorded as OWNER-DECISIONS 3k(x) and in the contract/spec: a voided log keeps its slot, a restatement is a correction, re-entry at the same minute is refused. Changing the constraint is an integrator decision because the legacy page depends on it.
findings.reverified: probe 5 asserts the 23505 at the voided slot as documented behaviour

findings.finding: finalize_drill_log checked deleted_at only on the unlocked read; a service/owner soft delete racing the FOR UPDATE could finalize a deleted draft.
findings.fix: Every finalize/correct/void command re-checks deleted_at after the FOR UPDATE re-read (Operation unavailable, 42501).
findings.reverified: migration applies; probes PASS; the reviewer confirmed authenticated cannot soft-delete a draft under the 220 policy, so the reachable path was service/owner only

findings.finding: The migration self-check asserted no operation_source_events at all (would fail hosted once 346 is exercised) and returned silently when the organisation constant was absent.
findings.fix: Assertion scoped to source keys drill-log/asset-observation; RAISE NOTICE on the missing-organisation path.
findings.reverified: migration applies on the clone; probe §0 unchanged

findings.finding: Contract §2/§4 (as first written) said recorded_at = version_recorded_at; the code anchors on finalized_at.
findings.fix: Contract §2 'Recording act' / 'Version act' and the reader table now state finalized_at as the recording instant on every version and version_recorded_by as the recorder, matching 344.

findings.finding: A correction by someone other than the observer flips the entry to on_behalf and needs an entry_reason (policy (ii) consequence; UX trap).
findings.fix: OWNER-DECISIONS 3k(ix), contract §5 and the spec API section state it.
findings.reverified: probe 3a: administrator correcting maintenance's observation is refused without entry_reason and recorded on_behalf with it (recorder administrator, performer maintenance)

findings.finding: The legacy upsert with identical content on a final row succeeds silently (touches updated_at); the page can no longer attach evidence paths to a final log.
findings.fix: Contract §3.1 and OWNER-DECISIONS 3k(x) state the accepted regression; the 343 evidence mechanism is the path.

findings.finding: Request keys are unique globally, not per organisation (key-existence oracle across organisations); same shape as 346.
Two different records under the same key from two sessions: the second failed at the request insert with a generic 23505 (no partial state).
findings.fix: finalize/correct/void now take the request-key advisory lock before the record lock (same order as record), so the second waits and is answered by the replay/conflict check.
findings.reverified: race script same_key_twice PASS; lock order key → record → 346 per-record; no deadlock observed across the six cases

findings.finding: Opposite-direction concurrent moves of two records between two occurrences could deadlock in 346's moved branch (40P01 → uncertain).
Route details: list query 'voided' filter was missing from the contract; builder usage correct; no wording leak found.
